title: Transradial Access in Peripheral Vascular Interventions
summary: Das Ziel der klinischen Prüfung ist es, eine Machbarkeitsanalyse des transradialen Zugangs bei der Behandlung von atherosklerotischen Läsionen der iliakalen Arterien unter Verwendung eines ballonexpandierbaren Stentsystems mit einer Arbeitslänge von 170 cm durchzuführen.

interventions.name:
All PAD patients >18 Jahre who receive a PTA of the iliac arteries will be asked to participate in the clinical trial.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients > 18 years
2. Patient has been informed about the type of study, duration and follow-up examination and has signed the informed consent
3. Reference vessel diameter (RVD) of the radial artery suitable for 6F access (sonographically determined)
4. Openness of the radial artery and ulnar artery (sonographically determined)
5. De-novo or restenotic lesion with > 70% stenosis (as assessed by the examiner) of the iliac arteries
6. Lesion is suitable for PTA or stenting
7. Rutherford Category 2-6
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patients < 18 years 
2. Participation in another drug, medical device or biological study
3. Acute vascular occlusions
4. Acute myocardial infarction < 30 days before the index procedure
5. Acute stroke < 30 days before the index procedure
6. Pregnant or breastfeeding patients
7. Life expectancy < 1 year
8. Patients with previous aortic arch embolisms or aortic arch procedures
9. Patients with sonographically confirmed occlusion of the radial artery or ulnar artery
10. Aneurysms in the target vessel
11. ASA/clopidogrel intolerance
12. Rutherford Category 0-1
